title: Fairness to Pet Owners Act of 2014
short_title: Fairness to Pet Owners Act of 2014

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

summaries.text:
Fairness to Pet Owners Act of 2014 - Directs the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) to require prescribers of animal drugs to verify prescriptions and provide copies of prescriptions to pet owners, pet owner designees, and pharmacies, without the prescriber demanding payment or establishing other conditions. 
 Treats a violation of this Act as an unfair or deceptive act or practice under the Federal Trade Commission Act.
